summary: Frontend-only regression + feature test for the new 13-skin system. Verified: (1) default skin 96 renders Terminal exactly as before (infrared MIRRORS logo, GODMODE SOUND hero, SCOPE/NODE, CODES_LAB, LATTICE, SEND CODES + CODES ARCHIVE modals visible, EXECUTE button, no console pageerror). (2) Hidden skin selector opens via long-press on the hero logo (data-testid='hero-logo'); all 13 skin rows exist with the exact testIDs skin-symbiote, skin-t800, skin-t1000, skin-doom, skin-winter, skin-ny96, skin-chakra, skin-y1950, skin-y1960, skin-y1970, skin-y1980, skin-y96, skin-y2000; skin-close closes it. (3) Cycled through all 13 skins one after the other — no crash, no blank screen, no pageerror; picker stayed open through every switch (lives outside keyed tree as designed) and the tree behind it repainted. (4) Persistence: selected 1980, reloaded, 1980 remained active (● marker on that row) — AsyncStorage key @godmode_skin_v1 works. (5) Light skins WINTER and 1950 both render with light backgrounds and readable text (no invisible/blown-out text observed at hero, top nav pills, SCOPE, CODES_LAB header, chip rows). (6) Cross-screen theming under DOOM: navigated HOME, CODES ARCHIVE (library), SOUND, BI-NAURAL (binaural), STATES (moods), MIRRORS ID, HOW — all render non-empty content (696–12302 chars) with no red screen. (7) Audio: EXECUTE started a tone, TRANSMITTING indicator appeared, and switching skin during playback did not crash the app; hero + STOP button remained available afterwards. No console pageerror captured across the entire session. No deprecated-package or SafeAreaView issues introduced by the codemod.
action_items: No action items — the 13-skin system is functionally complete and the default-96 look is pixel-preserved. Ship.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice: `SkinPicker` lives outside the `<View key={skin-${epoch}}>` remounted tree in _layout.tsx, which is exactly why it stays open through skin swaps.
Nice: `mapColorFor` short-circuits when active skin === DEFAULT_SKIN_ID (y96), guaranteeing pixel-identical output on default.

Minor (not a bug, informational): the `skinStyles` Proxy re-creates a StyleSheet per skin id on first access — expected & cached, but note that any component that memoizes a StyleSheet.create result outside skinStyles will not repaint. Codemod appears to have handled this correctly across ~40 files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 13-skin system verified working end-to-end. testIDs: hero-logo, skin-close, and skin-{id} for all 13 skins. Persistence key is @godmode_skin_v1 (AsyncStorage). If you re-test, note that after starting audio via EXECUTE the RN ScrollView scrolls the hero off-screen — Playwright's window.scrollTo does NOT scroll the internal ScrollView; use `page.evaluate` to scroll the actual scroll container, or open the picker BEFORE starting audio.
